messages:
Maya L: hey everyone, Maya here — first day in CS! quick checklist so I can be productive today: HubSpot, Dialpad (EU team uses Dialpad), playbooks + ramp one-pager, and access to recorded calls. who should I tag for each? :wave:
Ravi (IT): welcome Maya! @Maya L i sent the HubSpot invite and created a Dialpad seat request for you. watch for emails from hubspot-invite@redwood and dialpad@notifications. HubSpot will ask you to set up MFA.
Maya L: thanks Ravi — will keep an eye out. is Dialpad configured to push voicemails to tickets?
Carlos S: @Maya L yes — Dialpad -> Zendesk ticket flow for EU is enabled. For HubSpot you'll get the CS role (contacts, tickets, playbooks). I also added you to the shared playbooks folder and the "Ramp One-Pager" doc.
Nina (sales-ops): hey Maya — I manage the playbook copies. the recommended sequence this week: 1) listen to two recorded onboarding calls, 2) shadow an account handoff, 3) run through the CS first-week checklist. Link: https://internal.redwood/playbooks/cs/ramp-one-pager
Onboarding Bot: Reminder: complete the "Sales/CS Tools" checklist in the onboarding portal within 48 hours to avoid seat delays: https://onboard.redwood/checklists/sales-cs
Maya L: i can't find the objection cheat sheet in the drive, is there a canonical name?
Carlos S: file is "CS_OBJECTION_PLAY_v1" in /playbooks/cs/cheatsheets — i'll DM the link. also grab the outbound script named `cs_eu_templates_v3` in Notion for Dialpad macros.
Ravi (IT): Dialpad invite resent. If the setup link fails, tell me OS and browser. Also note recording is enabled by default for training; DM compliance if you'd like it disabled for early calls.
Maya L: received HubSpot and Dialpad, MFA set. headset tested. thanks all :raised_hands: one more Q — who schedules the playbook walkthrough?
Nina (sales-ops): I'll set up a 30-min walkthrough with @Carlos S and a buddy for week 1. check your calendar for the invite. welcome aboard! :tada:
